Aries.notes: No classic yogakaraka; Sun rules H5 (trikona) making it a strong functional benefic, but it does not also rule a kendra to qualify as yogakaraka.

Taurus.notes: Saturn rules H9 (Capricorn, trikona) and H10 (Aquarius, kendra), satisfying the dual lordship criterion for yogakaraka.

Gemini.notes: Mercury rules H1 (lagna/kendra) and H4 (Virgo, kendra); both are kendras with no trikona lordship, so the yogakaraka condition is not met.

Cancer.notes: Mars rules H5 (Scorpio, trikona) and H10 (Aries, kendra), satisfying the dual lordship criterion for yogakaraka.

Leo.notes: Mars rules H4 (Scorpio, kendra) and H9 (Aries, trikona), satisfying the dual lordship criterion for yogakaraka.

Virgo.notes: Mercury rules H1 (lagna/kendra) and H10 (Gemini, kendra); no trikona lordship, so the yogakaraka condition is not met.

Libra.notes: Saturn rules H4 (Capricorn, kendra) and H5 (Aquarius, trikona), satisfying the dual lordship criterion for yogakaraka.

Scorpio.notes: No planet cleanly rules both a kendra and a trikona for Scorpio lagna; Mars rules H1 (kendra) and H6 (maraka zone), Jupiter rules H2 and H5 — no clean yogakaraka emerges.

Sagittarius.notes: Jupiter rules H1 (lagna/kendra) and H4 (Pisces, kendra); both are kendras with no trikona lordship, so the yogakaraka condition is not met.

Capricorn.notes: Venus rules H5 (Taurus, trikona) and H10 (Libra, kendra), satisfying the dual lordship criterion for yogakaraka.

Aquarius.notes: Venus rules H4 (Taurus, kendra) and H9 (Libra, trikona), satisfying the dual lordship criterion for yogakaraka.

Pisces.notes: Jupiter rules H1 (lagna/kendra) and H10 (Sagittarius, kendra); both are kendras with no trikona lordship, so the yogakaraka condition is not met.
